articles.title: Best time trackers for developers, for code and for AI
articles.description: WakaTime is the best pick for per-file, per-language and AI-code metrics from your editor. ActivityWatch is the best free option that keeps data on your machine. TimeUno fits if you want whole-desktop tracking with AI agent sessions from tools like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI. Toggl and Clocki
articles.content: WakaTime is the best pick for per-file, per-language and AI-code metrics from your editor. ActivityWatch is the best free option that keeps data on your machine. TimeUno fits if you want whole-desktop tracking with AI agent sessions from tools like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI. Toggl and Clockify suit developers who mainly need client timesheets and invoices. git-hours and similar scripts give a rough estimate from commit history when nothing else was running. Last reviewed: November 2026.
articles.author: Kobe Cuppens
